The '''Mephout system''' was located in the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]<ref name="EAOC" /> [[Sector/Legends|sector]]<ref name="Journal11" /> known as the [[Mephout Dominion/Legends|Mephout Dominion]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was home to the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] known as the [[Mephout]].<ref name="Journal11" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

The area of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] surrounding the Mephout [[Star system/Legends|system]] was [[Scout/Legends|explored]] between [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]] and [[25 BBY/Legends|25 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" /> Shortly after the acquisition of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ukio/Legends|Ukio]] by the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Mephout system was featured on a [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Map/Legends|map]] displayed on a [[Viewscreen/Legends|viewscreen]] at a facility run by [[Passel Argente/Legends|Passel Argente]], the [[Magistrate/Legends|Magistrate]]<ref name="AoI">''[[The Clone Wars: Act on Instinct]]''</ref> of the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]].<ref name="DB Argente">{{DB|character|passelargente|Argente, Passel}}</ref>

The [[Firefist|extragalactic]] [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] raiders successfully [[Attack on the Mephout system|assaulted]] the Mephout system in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]<ref name="TEA" /> as part of an attack on the government of the Mephout Dominion.<ref name="ForgottenWar">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/nagai11202009/index.html|text=The Forgotten War: The Nagai and the Tofs|int=The Forgotten War: The Nagai and the Tofs}}</ref> The Mephout system's population around [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]] numbered between ten million and one hundred million.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Mephout system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square H-20.<ref name="TEA" /> ''[[The Clone Wars: Act on Instinct]]'', a [[Star Wars comic books|webcomic]] authored by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and released on [[StarWars.com]]<ref name="AoI" /> over the span of the 2009<ref name="AoI announcement">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/news20091001comics/index.html|text=New ''Clone Wars'' Web Comic Tells Original Tale}}</ref>&ndash;[[2010]]<ref name="Lethal Trackdown Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode222.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Lethal Trackdown}}</ref> [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series,<ref name="AoI announcement" /> featured the first appearance of the system.<ref name="AoI" />
